description.en: Agent-requested context compaction at semantic turn boundaries, with a per-session suggested threshold kept below the harness rail.
description.zh: 让 agent 在语义合适的边界自主请求上下文压缩，阈值按会话设置并始终低于系统自动压缩线。

description.en: Lets the agent choose when to compact: a live budget reading, a per-session threshold below the built-in rail, and a visible compaction run at the end of the turn.
description.zh: 让 agent 自己挑压缩时机：实时读数、低于系统线的会话阈值，压缩在回合结束后可见地执行。
